urgent_or_prompt_assessment: new confusion, hallucinations, severe depression or suicidality with cycloserine/terizidone

rag_rules: Do not assume all neuropathy in a person with TB is drug-induced.
For linezolid, pyridoxine should not be presented as proven prevention of linezolid neuropathy.
For isoniazid, retrieve current guideline recommendations for pyridoxine prophylaxis and treatment rather than relying on model memory.
For cycloserine/terizidone, evaluate neuropsychiatric symptoms separately from peripheral neuropathy.
Do not autonomously instruct patients to stop or restart anti-TB medication; route medication changes to the treating team unless an official patient-safety pathway explicitly says otherwise.
